questions.q: In "Kick-off circle Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Peers ask three questions: what does it cost, where does it go after use, does it work in real conditions.
Single-use cup 0.05 each. Reusable cup 2.00. Break-even uses = 2.00 / 0.05 = 40 uses (ignoring washing).
Estimate the number of uses a reusable item needs to break even on materials.
List single-use items you see in a day: bag, bottle, straw, cutlery, food tray, wrap, sachet.

questions.q: In "Lifecycle thinking, standards and sourcing Apply", which of these is a key idea?
